Yes, Acme Checkout supports saving cards for repeat customers via secure tokenization.

Using this feature does not increase your PCI compliance requirements. Because Acme Checkout securely hosts the payment forms and stores the cardholder data on our PCI-compliant infrastructure, sensitive card details never touch your servers. The Acme Team

proposal.customer_reply:
Bonjour Chloé!

To display prices in EUR at checkout, you can update your currency settings directly from your Acme Checkout dashboard:

1. Log in to your Acme dashboard and go to **Settings** > **Currencies**.
2. Set your **Presentment Currency** (or default checkout currency) to **EUR (€)**.
3. Click **Save**.

Your checkout will now present prices to your customers in EUR. Please let us know if you need any additional help getting this configured!
